items.text: I can explain what SDLC is and name all 6 phases in order
I understand the difference between Waterfall and Agile and when to use each
I can explain the difference between a program, software, and an application with examples
I understand how a computer works (CPU, RAM, Storage, Network)
I can explain the client-server model and trace a request-response cycle
I understand IP addresses, ports, and protocols (know port numbers for HTTP, HTTPS, SSH)
I can explain CapEx vs OpEx and why cloud converts CapEx to OpEx
I can explain cloud computing and its benefits over traditional on-premise infrastructure
I can explain the client-server model clearly to a non-technical person using an analogy
I can trace a web request from browser click to server response and back
I can explain why a server running multiple services uses different ports for each
I can make a financial argument for cloud adoption (CapEx vs OpEx, utilization rates)
I successfully explored the AWS Management Console and found the region selector and services menu
I can answer: 'What are the phases of SDLC?' without hesitation
I know the port numbers: HTTP=80, HTTPS=443, SSH=22, MySQL=3306
I can distinguish between CapEx and OpEx and identify which cloud uses
I know the three major cloud providers and their key differentiators (AWS, Azure, GCP)
I can explain why cloud computing solves the utilization problem that plagues on-premise infrastructure
